transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you and what brings you in today?

Hi. Thanks. Well, I guess what really made me decide to come in is that for the past few weeks, my eating has just been... off. I’ll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then I just kind of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooks. I've also noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose. So, that's mainly what's been going on.
Have you been worried about gaining weight or noticing changes in your body shape recently?

No, not at all. I haven't been worried about gaining weight or anything like that. It's not about how I look or my body shape. I just haven't had much of an appetite lately, so I haven't been eating. That's really all it is.
Have you noticed that you’re not getting as much pleasure or interest from things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or time with family?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I still enjoy doing my normal stuff. I still like hanging out with my wife and, you know, doing the things I usually like to do. I'm still interested in all of that. It really is just the food thing that's been off.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?

Yeah, I guess I have. I know I just said it was mostly the food thing, but... well, most days lately I do wake up with this heavy, flat feeling. It's just like the apartment is too quiet. And even picking up my guitar doesn't really lift me out of it. So, yeah, I have been feeling pretty down.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up earlier than you'd like?

Yeah, I mean... I am sleeping, but it's pretty broken up. I keep waking up early, usually around four or five in the morning. My mind just starts going, thinking about bills or, you know, unfinished tracks I've been working on. Once that happens, I can't really get back to sleep, so I just end up feeling tired before the day even really starts.
Have you been feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately, or feeling like you're not worth much?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I mean, I don't feel worthless or anything. I'm not sitting around blaming myself for things... it's just more of that heavy, flat feeling I mentioned earlier. But no, no real guilt or anything like that.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy, even things that normally make you happy?

Um, no, not really. I still like doing my usual stuff. I mean, I know I said earlier that playing guitar hasn't been snapping me out of that flat feeling, but I still actually want to play it. I haven't lost interest in it, or... or anything else I usually enjoy. I still like doing those things.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety in a way that's different from how you normally are?

Yeah, I guess everything just feels a bit slower right now. Like, I'll sit there with my laptop open for ages before I even move my hands to type anything, or even just to plug in the keyboard. It just takes me longer to get moving.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or felt unusually tired lately, even if you’re not doing much?

No, my energy feels about normal, honestly. I'm not feeling unusually tired or wiped out. Like I said, it takes me a bit longer to get moving, but it's not because I'm exhausted or anything. I just... I don't know, it's just slow. But physically, my energy levels seem fine.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight in the past month without trying to?

Yeah, I think I probably have. For the past few weeks, my eating has just been really off. I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without even meaning to, honestly. And then at dinner, I just kind of pick at my food, even when my wife cooks a full meal. I haven't actually stepped on a scale to know the exact percentage or anything, but my jeans are definitely starting to feel loose.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?

Yeah, actually, I have. It's been pretty frustrating. Like, when I try to work on some code or... or arrange a song, I just can't seem to focus. I'll keep rereading the same line of code over and over, or I'll replay the same eight bars of a song, and I just... I still can't decide what to do next with it. It's like my brain just gets stuck and I can't think it through.
Even though you still enjoy your usual activities, have you found that you’re not really interested in doing them as much as you used to be, or have you been doing them less often?

No, I wouldn't say that. I'm still doing the things I normally do. I mean, I still play my guitar and try to work on my music, even if I get stuck sometimes like I mentioned. But the interest is still there. I haven't stopped wanting to do my hobbies or anything like that.
Have you had any thoughts about life not being worth living or considered harming yourself in any way?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. Life's definitely been a bit frustrating lately with my focus being off and all, but I haven't thought about harming myself or anything. I don't feel like life isn't worth living.
Have you found it harder than usual to focus on tasks, make decisions, or think things through clearly?

I think we actually just talked about that a minute ago. But yeah, it's definitely been harder to focus and make decisions. Like I was saying with my music and coding, my brain just kind of gets stuck and I can't think things through clearly right now.
Even though you still do your usual activities, have you noticed that you care less about them or get less enjoyment out of them compared to before?

No, not really. I think I still care about them just as much. Um... the enjoyment is definitely still there, you know? It's really just the focus part that's getting in the way, like I was saying, but I still actually like doing my music and everything. I haven't lost that feeling.
Would you say that you’re getting less pleasure or enjoyment out of your usual activities compared to how you used to feel when doing them?

I feel like we just covered this, but no, not really. I mean, I still get the same amount of enjoyment out of things. It's just... like I said, it's harder to focus on them right now. But the actual pleasure I get from my music and stuff hasn't changed.
Have you noticed that your thoughts are racing or that you're having trouble organizing your thoughts or focusing on tasks?

I feel like we've kind of gone over this a few times now. But yeah, like I said earlier, I'm definitely having trouble focusing on things. My thoughts aren't really racing, though. It's more just that my brain gets stuck and I can't concentrate or organize what I'm trying to do.
